mnemonic.meaning: 強 strong: it becomes stronger.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUYO, MARU!" (つよまる) The strong ball spins faster.

examples.ja: 夜になって風が強まった。
examples.en: The wind got stronger at night.

items.note: Intransitive partner of 強める (Level 9).

mnemonic.meaning: 次 next: coming next.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUGU!" (つぐ) Same sound as 継ぐ (Level 10).

examples.ja: 大阪は東京に次ぐ大都市だ。
examples.en: Osaka is the biggest city after Tokyo.

items.note: 〜に次ぐ = second only to. 相次ぐ = to happen one after another.

mnemonic.meaning: 印 mark + 刷 print: printing marks.
mnemonic.reading: "IN, SATSU!" (いんさつ) Ink on the paper money (札, さつ).

examples.ja: 資料を十部印刷した。
examples.en: I printed ten copies of the handout.

items.note: プリントする is also common. 印刷機 = printing press.

mnemonic.meaning: 発 start + 明 bright: a bright idea started.
mnemonic.reading: "HATSU, MAY!" (はつめい) The first (初) idea in May.

examples.ja: 電話はベルが発明した。
examples.en: The telephone was invented by Bell.

items.note: Inventing something new. Discovering what exists is 発見 (はっけん).

mnemonic.meaning: 会 meet + 合 join: meeting and joining.
mnemonic.reading: "KAI, GOU!" (かいごう) Kai goes to the meeting.

examples.ja: 地域の会合に参加した。
examples.en: I took part in a local meeting.

items.note: Formal gathering of a group. 会議 is a meeting to discuss and decide.

mnemonic.meaning: 間 interval + 隔 gap: the gap between.
mnemonic.reading: "KAN, KAKU!" (かんかく) Same sound as 感覚 (sense, feeling).

examples.ja: バスは十分間隔で来る。
examples.en: Buses come every ten minutes.

items.note: Time or space between: 間隔を空ける (leave space).

mnemonic.meaning: 日 sun + 中 middle: in the middle of the sun's hours.
mnemonic.reading: "NICCHUU!" (にっちゅう) Also means Japan-China (日中関係).

examples.ja: 日中はとても暑かった。
examples.en: It was very hot during the day.

items.note: Context matters: 日中関係 = Japan-China relations.

mnemonic.meaning: 辞 resign + 退 withdraw: stepping back.
mnemonic.reading: "JEE, TAI!" (じたい) Gee, tie it off: I decline. Same sound as 事態 (situation).

examples.ja: 彼は賞の受け取りを辞退した。
examples.en: He declined to accept the award.

items.note: Polite, formal refusal of an offer or a post. 断る is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 発 discharge + 行 carry out: sending it out.
mnemonic.reading: "HAK, KOU!" (はっこう) Hack, go: the card is issued.

examples.ja: 新しいカードが発行された。
examples.en: A new card was issued.

items.note: Issuing passports, tickets, magazines, currency.

mnemonic.meaning: 主 main + 要 essential: main and essential.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOE, YOU!" (しゅよう) Shoes are your main need.

examples.ja: 主要な都市を回った。
examples.en: We toured the major cities.

items.note: Formal. 主な is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 前 before + 者 one: the one before.
mnemonic.reading: "ZEN, SHA!" (ぜんしゃ) Zen's first choice.

examples.ja: 前者と後者では、前者のほうが安い。
examples.en: Of the former and the latter, the former is cheaper.

items.note: Pair with 後者 (Level 14).

mnemonic.meaning: 需 demand + 要 essential: what is demanded as essential.
mnemonic.reading: "JUU, YOU!" (じゅよう) Ten (十) of you want it: demand.

examples.ja: 夏はエアコンの需要が高まる。
examples.en: Demand for air conditioners rises in summer.

items.note: 需要と供給 = supply and demand.

mnemonic.meaning: 順 = 川 (river) + 頁 (head): following like a river flows.
mnemonic.reading: "JUN!" (じゅん) June comes in order after May.

examples.ja: 名前の順に並んでください。
examples.en: Please line up in order of name.

items.note: 順番 is everyday. 順に = in order. Also in 順調 (Level 1).

mnemonic.meaning: 減 decrease + 少 few: becoming fewer.
mnemonic.reading: "GEN, SHOU!" (げんしょう) The general's show loses viewers. Same sound as 現象 (phenomenon).

examples.ja: 日本の人口は減少している。
examples.en: Japan's population is decreasing.

items.note: Formal. 減る is everyday. 増加 (ぞうか) = increase.

mnemonic.meaning: 金 money + 銭 coin: money and coins.
mnemonic.reading: "KIN, SEN!" (きんせん) The king's coins.

examples.ja: 金銭のトラブルを避けたい。
examples.en: I want to avoid money trouble.

items.note: Formal. お金 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 撒 has 扌 (hand): scattering by hand.
mnemonic.reading: "MAKU!" (まく) Same sound as 巻く (wind) and 蒔く (sow).

examples.ja: 庭に水を撒いた。
examples.en: I sprinkled water in the garden.

items.note: Usually in kana: まく. 種をまく = sow seeds (蒔く).

mnemonic.meaning: 沖 has 氵 (water) + 中 (middle): the middle of the water.
mnemonic.reading: "OKI!" (おき) 沖縄 starts with it.

examples.ja: 船は沖に出た。
examples.en: The boat went out to sea.

items.note: The sea away from the shore. 沖合 = offshore.

mnemonic.meaning: 遅 late: being late.
mnemonic.reading: "OKURE!" (おくれ) From 遅れる (to be late).

examples.ja: 電車に十分の遅れが出ている。
examples.en: The train is running ten minutes late.

items.note: 遅れを取る = to fall behind.

mnemonic.meaning: 混 mix + 雑 rough: a rough mix. A crowd.
mnemonic.reading: "KON, ZATSU!" (こんざつ) Konbini's packed.

examples.ja: 朝の駅はとても混雑している。
examples.en: Stations are very crowded in the morning.

items.note: Formal; 混む is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 農 farming + 家 house: a farming household.
mnemonic.reading: "NOU, KA!" (のうか) No car on the farm.

examples.ja: 祖父母は農家だ。
examples.en: My grandparents are farmers.

items.note: Also the farmhouse itself. 農業 = agriculture.

mnemonic.meaning: TABI (time) + TABI: time after time.

examples.ja: たびたびご迷惑をおかけしてすみません。
examples.en: I'm sorry to trouble you again and again.

items.note: Kanji: 度々. A bit formal; よく / 何度も are everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 馴 has 馬 (horse): a horse getting used to its rider. Tame.
mnemonic.reading: "NARERU!" (なれる) Same sound as 慣れる.

examples.ja: この猫は人に馴れている。
examples.en: This cat is used to people.

items.note: 馴れる is for animals and becoming familiar. 慣れる is the usual kanji for habits.

mnemonic.meaning: 便 = 亻 (person) + 更: a person delivering things.
mnemonic.reading: "BIN!" (びん) Same sound as 瓶 (bottle, Level 12).

examples.ja: 次の便で大阪に行きます。
examples.en: I'll go to Osaka on the next flight.

items.note: びん = flight, post: 航空便 (airmail). べん = convenience: 便利.

mnemonic.meaning: 正 exact + 午 noon: exactly noon.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOU, GO!" (しょうご) The show starts at noon: go!

examples.ja: 会議は正午に始まる。
examples.en: The meeting starts at noon.

items.note: Exactly 12:00. 午前 / 午後 = a.m. / p.m.

mnemonic.meaning: 適 suitable + 用 use: using it where it suits.
mnemonic.reading: "TEKI, YOU!" (てきよう) Take it, it applies to you.

examples.ja: この割引は学生にも適用される。
examples.en: This discount also applies to students.

items.note: Applying rules, laws, insurance. Not applying for a job (応募).

mnemonic.meaning: 県 is an administrative area.
mnemonic.reading: "KEN!" (けん) Ken from 千葉県.

examples.ja: 私は静岡県の出身です。
examples.en: I'm from Shizuoka Prefecture.

items.note: Japan has 43 県 plus 都 (Tokyo), 道 (Hokkaido) and 府 (Osaka, Kyoto).

mnemonic.meaning: 実 reality + 施 carry out: making it real.
mnemonic.reading: "JISSHI!" (じっし) Ji-shi: just do it.

examples.ja: 来月から新しい制度を実施する。
examples.en: We'll put the new system into effect from next month.

items.note: Formal; events, tests, policies. 実行 (Level 8) is carrying out a plan.

mnemonic.meaning: 長 long + 期 period: a long period.
mnemonic.reading: "CHOU, KEE!" (ちょうき) A long key.

examples.ja: 長期の休みを取った。
examples.en: I took a long break.

items.note: 短期 (たんき) = short-term. 長期的 = long-term.

mnemonic.meaning: 協 cooperate + 議 discuss: discussing together.
mnemonic.reading: "KYOU, GI!" (きょうぎ) Same sound as 競技 (competition).

examples.ja: 双方が協議を続けている。
examples.en: Both sides are continuing their discussions.

items.note: Formal talks. 話し合い is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 規 rule + 制 control: controlling with rules.
mnemonic.reading: "KEE, SAY!" (きせい) Same sound as 帰省 (going home).

examples.ja: 交通規制が行われている。
examples.en: Traffic restrictions are in place.

items.note: Rules imposed from above. 規則 (きそく) = a rule.
